ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a circle with K as the center, square FGHJ is inscribed in this circle, and the four vertices F, G, H, J are all on the circumference. In the figure, line segments from the circle center K to adjacent vertices G and H are drawn, so the central angle can be regarded as ∠GKH. Then reason: Because FGHJ is an inscribed square, the four vertices divide the circumference into four congruent arcs. The whole circle is 360°, so the central angle corresponding to each pair of adjacent vertices is 360° ÷ 4 = 90°.

method.method_draft: From the image, identify the central angle as the angle at center K formed by radii drawn from K to two adjacent vertices of the inscribed square, such as G and H. From the text, use that FGHJ is a square inscribed in circle K, so its four vertices lie on the circle and split the circle into four congruent arcs. A full circle measures 360 degrees, so each central angle between adjacent vertices is 360/4 = 90 degrees.
